name: btn-hover-outline
title: Outline Toggle Button
blurb: Background and text colours invert on hover.
description: A link-styled button with a dark background and light text. On hover, the background becomes light and text becomes dark, creating an invert effect.
use_when: A secondary CTA that should feel subtle until interaction.
avoid_when: When the invert might feel jarring.
a11y: Rendered as an anchor tag, which may cause accessibility issues depending on context.
